api_and_semantics.visibility: Package-private final JobQueue<R>, AttemptFactory<R>, Attempt<R>, Outcome<R>, Completion<R>. Only required interface/AutoCloseable implementations are public. No module changes.
api_and_semantics.composition: One private Controller with borrowed validated budget and measurements, resource-free factory and private apply method. Existing Policy selection remains unchanged.
api_and_semantics.ownership: Returned Attempt retained with identity before fallible start. Single caller thread; no asynchronous/reentrant operations or collaborator callbacks. Typed native outcomes remain unchanged.
api_and_semantics.control: One scheduling effect at most per cycle; current waits resume once and retain high-water mark; selected terminate saves checked completions+1 and STOPPING before request. Ambiguous failures permit reconciliation only, never repeated control.
api_and_semantics.reconciliation: Observe retained owners in original order; record each accepted outcome immediately, preserving it across a later poll failure. Complete observation batch before idempotent natural-completion accounting and conservative unexpected-abort threshold. Cleanup required before finish or RETRY.
api_and_semantics.cleanup: Close owner at most once. Failed cleanup permanently retains ownership context/original cause and blocks scheduling. Explicit close marks terminal state first, visits other retained owners and aggregates failures; repeated close preserves failure and does not retry native cleanup.
api_and_semantics.numeric: Positions/attempts/denials begin zero. Every successor and retry threshold uses Math.incrementExact before committing the mutation or issuing a new effect. No counter-seeding test API.
api_and_semantics.snapshots: Immutable ordered Policy.Job and Completion lists; finished names remain reserved, completion diagnostics survive close/failure. Cached residency may be zero/stale until Controller samples.
